description_en: Sends a DataChannel message to an AI agent
description_zh: 向智能体通话发送DataChannel消息
name: SendAIAgentDataChannelMessage

parameters.description_en: The ID of the AI agent in the conversation.
parameters.description_zh:
当前正在通话的智能体实例ID。

> InstanceId为智能体实例启动成功后，返回的唯一的Id。启动智能体接口，请参见[StartAIAgentInstance ](~~2846201~~)、[GenerateAIAgentCall](~~2846209~~)。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the AI agent in the conversation
parameters.help_zh:
当前正在通话的智能体实例ID。

> InstanceId为智能体实例启动成功后，返回的唯一的Id。启动智能体接口，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2846201.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2846209.html
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.description_en: The DataChannel message you want to send. You must specify a JSON string. The value can be up to 8,192 characters in length.
parameters.description_zh: 需要发送的datachannel消息。需要传入JSON字符串。字符串长度不超过8192。
parameters.help_en: The DataChannel message you want to send. You must specify a JSON string. The value can be up to 8,192 characters in length
